summary: A tower was erected at Rocky Mount in 1949 on a towersite the Missouri Conservation Commission owned; a tower was dismantled and moved to Jefferson City in 2000 (which one is not stated); the register now places the lookout at the Runge Conservation Nature Center; concrete bases remain at the original site.

facts.agency: Runge Conservation Nature Center (current site, per the register); the Missouri Conservation Commission owned the original towersite in 1949-50
facts.status_note: In 2000 a tower was dismantled and moved from the Rocky Mount towersite near Eldon to the Conservation Education Center in Jefferson City; sources do not say whether it was the 1949 tower or the 1968-69 steel tower. The register places the lookout at the Runge Conservation Nature Center in Cole County, and the original site keeps concrete bases

events.note: Fiscal 1947-48: a 40-acre towersite acquired (Forest Lookouts, citing a Missouri Conservation Commission annual report)
Built in the summer of 1949 per the register; Forest Lookouts: 'A tower was erected.'
Towerman Harold Gregg Hibdon struck by a car on March 30, 1950 while removing equipment at a brush fire; died in hospital in early April
Towerman P.A. Hess begins; register gives his service as 1956 to 1987
Fiscal 1968-69: a new steel tower erected at Rocky Mount; the fate of the 1949 tower is not stated
Hess's service ends in 1987 per the register
A tower dismantled and moved to the Conservation Education Center in Jefferson City; upper portion to be re-erected; the source does not say which tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record and register say Cole County, which matches the Runge Conservation Nature Center where the register places the lookout. The original Rocky Mount towersite is in Miller County, per MDC.

notes_for_editor: Which 1949 tower went to Runge is unclear. Forest Lookouts says a new steel tower was erected at Rocky Mount in fiscal 1968-69 and that a tower was moved in 2000, without saying which. The Runge caption says the tower there was formerly at Rocky Mount; no source read confirms the upper portion was re-erected or the tower's condition today, so 'standing' rests on the register's location. Heights for Runge found only in search snippets (72 ft, 55 ft, 77 ft at Rocky Mount) were not used. The register spells the site 'Rocky Mountain' once. The Waymarking page and a Missouri Life article were not readable through fetch_text. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story no longer says the Commission put the tower up, since no source names who erected it; the 2000 move is now attributed to 'a tower' with the ambiguity stated; the Miller County footnote now sits on the sentence that states it.
